title: Delivery times and costs
answer: Most in-stock items ship next business day. Furniture arrives in 3-5 business days. Delivery is free on orders of $500 or more; otherwise a flat $29.99 applies.

title: Returns policy
answer: Return most items within 30 days for a full refund. Furniture can be returned within 14 days in original packaging. Opened ink and toner cannot be returned.

title: Assembly service
answer: Professional assembly is available for desks, chairs and storage for a flat $79 per item, or $199 for a room of up to 5 items. Book it at checkout.

title: Warranty
answer: Office chairs carry a 5-year warranty, desks 3 years, electronics 1 year from the manufacturer. Ergonomic chairs carry a 10-year mechanism warranty.

title: Bulk and business orders
answer: Business accounts get volume pricing on orders of 10 or more chairs or desks, net-30 invoicing and a dedicated account manager. Orders over $10,000 require approval.

title: Choosing a desk size
answer: Allow at least 36 inches behind the desk for the chair. A 48" desk suits a laptop and one monitor; 60" fits two monitors; L-shaped desks suit corners and dual workflows.

title: Choosing a TV size for a meeting room
answer: A good rule: screen diagonal of about one inch for every 2.6 inches of distance from the farthest seat. For a 16-foot room, a 75" display works well.

title: Ergonomic setup
answer: Set chair height so feet rest flat, elbows at 90 degrees, and the top of the monitor at or just below eye level, about an arm's length away.

title: Ink and toner recycling
answer: Bring empty ink and toner cartridges to any store or mail them free to recycle them.

title: Price match
answer: We match a lower advertised price from major retailers on identical in-stock items at the time of purchase.

title: Payment methods

title: Tracking an order
answer: You'll get an email with tracking as soon as your order ships. Ask the assistant 'where is my order' with your order number for status.

title: Free room planning consultation
answer: Our design team plans offices of any size for free: send your room dimensions or a photo and we'll suggest a layout and a shopping list.

title: Setting up a home office in a bedroom
answer: In a bedroom, put the desk near a window for daylight, keep 36" of chair space, use a compact desk (40-48") and a chair mat to protect carpet.

title: Bundle offers
answer: Bundles apply automatically in your cart: desk + chair saves 15%, printer + 2 cartridges saves 10%, 3+ chairs save 10% (15% for 10+), and more.

title: Meeting room sizes
answer: Typical sizes: a huddle room is 100-150 sq ft for 2-5 people, with the table pushed against a wall display. A conference room is 250-350 sq ft for 8-14, with a table 3-4 ft wide and 8-12 ft long and at least 36 inches behind seated people. A boardroom is 400-600+ sq ft for 12-24, with a table 4-5 ft wide and up to 20 ft long, 48 inches of walking space round it and a credenza at the back. An executive suite is 150-200 sq ft: an L- or U-shaped desk facing the door, two guest chairs and a side table. Rooms for video calls need a display, a camera above it and a speakerphone or soundbar.
